models_evaluated: ADAE (open-source, non-commercial dermoscopy melanoma AI algorithm)

links.outcome: Dermatologist melanoma risk assessment accuracy before vs after AI score exposure
links.effect: Dermatologist AUC improved from 0.7798 to 0.8161 after ADAE exposure (p = 0.042); post-ADAE decisions had equivalent or higher net benefit than biopsying all lesions.
links.quote: The dermatologists' ability to assess melanoma risk significantly improved after ADAE exposure (AUC 0.7798 vs. 0.8161, p = 0.042).

links.outcome: Dermatologist melanoma-risk discrimination before and after real-time AI exposure
links.effect: Dermatologist melanoma-risk discrimination improved after ADAE exposure: AUC 0.7798 vs. 0.8161, p = 0.042.
links.quote: The dermatologists' ability to assess melanoma risk significantly improved after ADAE exposure (AUC 0.7798 vs. 0.8161, p = 0.042).

links.effect: At the predetermined 95% sensitivity threshold, the algorithm demonstrated a sensitivity of 96.8% and a specificity of 37.4%.
links.quote: At the predetermined 95% sensitivity threshold, ADAE had a sensitivity of 96.8% (95% CI: 91.1-98.9%) and specificity of 37.4% (95% CI: 33.3-41.7%).

links.effect: Dermatologists' AUC improved from 0.7798 without AI to 0.8161 with AI exposure (p = 0.042).
links.quote: The dermatologists' ability to assess melanoma risk significantly improved after ADAE exposure (AUC 0.7798 vs. 0.8161, p = 0.042).
